source: OpenStreetMap admin_level=8 commune relations and their admin_centre nodes, via Overpass, each node re-read from the OpenStreetMap node API. Every published coordinate is that node. One row (Beni-Abbes 5201) additionally carries a reading the project owner took from a proprietary map, recorded as a confirmation of the open value and never as the value itself.
method: Wilaya capital (chef-lieu) communes only, and a different standard from the two earlier batches, because containment cannot see this class: all five stored centres are INSIDE their own commune, 3 to 6 km from the town. A row qualifies when it is a wilaya capital commune, its stored centre is more than 3 km from its relation's admin_centre node, and claims this correction is not derived from put the town at the node rather than at the stored centre: the wilaya's own published point (from its admin_level=4 relation, a different OpenStreetMap object) is nearer the node, and so is the geometric median of the geo_precision: exact records other packages place inside this commune's own OpenStreetMap outline, selected by point-in-polygon rather than by the commune they name. Over all 69 capitals that two-claim criterion selects exactly four, and the fifth row here is NOT one of them. Beni-Abbes (5201) is the only other capital more than 3 km from its node, and the wilaya-point leg argues against it: wilaya 52's own capital point is 6.7 km from the stored centre and 8.8 km from the town, because that point is itself about 8.8 km out, which is #228 to fix. So the criterion did not nominate it; the Owner did, on 2026-10-01, reading the town centre off Google Maps. THE OWNER'S READING IS NOT WHAT SHIPS. The Owner's rule of the same day: a coordinate read off a proprietary map may only CONFIRM an open source, within 500 m, and the open coordinate is what is published. The reading agrees with this commune's own admin_centre node to 268 m, so the node is written like the other four rows and the reading is recorded in `owner_confirmation`. All five published values are therefore ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, all five count in the licence carve-out, and no proprietary map is the provenance of any coordinate here. Beni-Abbes is evidenced by the exact-record median (139 m from the node, against 5,628 m from the stored centre) plus that confirmation; its relation, 6530989, also carries the pre-reform ref:ONS 0807. `to` is that node rounded to 6 decimals in every row, re-read from api.openstreetmap.org on 2026-10-01; every row also records the node coordinate in `osm.admin_centre_point` so any of them can be re-checked offline. A seat delta on its own is NOT a defect (the Owner's 2026-09-29 decision, private tracker #170): 132 non-capital centres stay more than 3 km from their seat, measured against osm-seat-reference.json after this batch, and none of them is corrected here; after this batch Beni-Abbes is no longer the one capital left in that band either. Applied by scripts/fix-commune-centres.mjs; held by test/capital-centre-near-seat.test.mjs.

owner_confirmation.note: A CONFIRMATION, never the published value. The Owner read the town centre of Beni-Abbes off Google Maps and supplied 30.1310763, -2.1663499, which agrees with this commune's own OpenStreetMap admin_centre node to 268 m. The Owner's rule of 2026-10-01: a reading taken from a proprietary map may only confirm an open source, within 500 m, and it is the open coordinate that ships. So `to` is the OpenStreetMap node and this reading is recorded as the check that nominated and corroborated it. No proprietary map is the provenance of any published coordinate here, and this row is ODbL like the other four.

osm.name: Béni Abbès ⴰⵢⵜ ⴰⴱⴱⴰⵙ بني عباس
osm.note: This row's published value. The relation carries the PRE-REFORM ref:ONS 0807 (Bechar), so it joined on that code plus the name inside the mother wilaya rather than on 5201 directly. The node was re-read from api.openstreetmap.org on 2026-10-01 and its coordinate is stored here, so the row re-checks offline.

evidence.wilaya_point_note: The only one of the five where the wilaya-point claim argues AGAINST the move: wilaya 52's own capital point is itself about 8.8 km from its capital's town centre, which is yasserstudio/geoalgeria.com#228 to fix and not this batch. So this row is NOT selected by the two-claim criterion the other four meet. It was nominated by the Owner and evidenced by the exact-record median plus the Owner's own independent reading, which confirms the published node to 268 m.
